video_title: It's time to go big or go home...or maybe a bit of both
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies Fanttik as the sponsor of SYD and MACKY's August 8, 2026 English-language YouTube video and quotes the disclosure: 'This video is sponsored by Fanttik, the maker of the X10 Ace Mini and X10 Ace Tiny air compressors.' SponsorRadar tracks Fanttik across 140 YouTube creators, including SYD and MACKY (~131K subscribers). Fanttik's official Affiliate Program actively supports social-platform promotion and publishes publish@fanttik.com as its official affiliate-team email; its official contact page separately lists marketing@fanttik.com for Marketing. Fanttik sells tangible automotive tools and consumer hardware.
